verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is entirely about GitHub Mobile's app features (Copilot agent tasks, code review, notifications) and contains no documentation of a corresponding API that mirrors these mobile-specific UI capabilities; the only API-related probe (OpenAPI spec) returned 404s. missing for 10: any documented API endpoints for agent task management, mobile code review actions, or notification triage that would let an AI agent replicate mobile UI actions programmatically.
